BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE.description: Upgrade every upgradable card in your hand for THIS combat (Armaments-class, reverts after). Spend on highest hand-density / lethal-intent turns. BLOCK_POTION.description: Gain 12 Block on use. Uncommon-class reserve potion for lethal-intent turns and boss gates. LIVE run-40: consumed Decimillipede T4 — 12 + Evil Eye 16 (Unmovable-doubled) = 28 vs 32 incoming at 34 HP. Potion-sourced block does NOT double with Unmovable (card-block only).
BLOCK_POTION.name: Block Potion

BLOOD_POTION.description: Common, anytime: heal 20% of Max HP (run-49 live 80 Max→+16; run-57 95-class Max→+19). Corridor sustain — drink BEFORE the lethal-class turn, not after. run-57: spent mid-Decimillipede at incoming-28-class window, raised 46→65 buffer for the multi-turn grind.
BLOOD_POTION.name: Blood Potion
BLOOD_POTION.play_notes: Run-49 live: drank mid-Entomancer at HP 23→39 (20% of 80 = 16). Corridor sustain class — spend BEFORE the lethal turn, not after.

BOTTLED_POTENTIAL.description: move your hand into the draw pile, shuffle the draw pile, draw 5.

CURE_ALL.name: Cure All

DEXTERITY_POTION.description: Gain 2 Dexterity for the combat (card-block +2, stacks with OddlySmoothStone). Live run-43: Dex1+2=3 total; Defend 6+3=9, TrueGrit 8+3=11, UltimateDefend 13+3=16 - 16>=15 solo-stunned BowlbugRock HEADBUTT. Bowlbug doctrine note run-39: Dex+Defend x2=14 was one short of 15 - always compute the live total vs the intent number before concluding stun is impossible.
DEXTERITY_POTION.name: Dexterity Potion

DISTILLED_CHAOS.description: Play the top 3 cards of your Draw Pile. Variance-class - cost/targets uncontrolled. Shop (5,0) Act2 live price 102g run-43 (not bought).

DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.description: choose 1 card from your draw pile; add it to hand.
DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION.name: Droplet of Precognition

DUPLICATOR.description: Apply DuplicationPower 1 — the next card you play this combat is played 1 extra time; removed at end of turn. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): Pommel Strike 9 resolved twice (18) on a kill turn; potions are NOT cards for RINGING-class counters (run-48 rule held).
DUPLICATOR.name: Duplicator

EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.description: deal 10 damage to ALL enemies (automatic multi-target; do not send a target id).
EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE.name: Explosive Ampoule

FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: On lethal damage, revive at 30% of Max HP (live run-52: 24/80 from a Crimson Mantle tick death mid-combat) and the potion is consumed. Proc fires from ANY lethal source including unblockable self-damage ticks — not only enemy attacks. Boss-corridor reserve value: once spent in a hall fight the endgame has no revive buffer (run-52 lesson).
FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE.name: Fairy in a Bottle

FIRE_POTION.description: Deal 20 damage — typeless: NOT amplified by Vulnerable or SLOW stacks. run-50 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-115250-401c95c0.log): exact 20 on Marbles-Vuln'd Insatiable confirmed; do not count potion damage in Vuln/Slow window math.
FIRE_POTION.name: Fire Potion
FIRE_POTION.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: flat 20 under Vuln2+Slow display — un-amped confirmed. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]

FLEX_POTION.description: Gain +5 Strength for this turn only (temporary; expires end of turn).
FLEX_POTION.name: Flex Potion
FLEX_POTION.play_notes: Run-49 live: STR +5 applied same turn (powers showed STRENGTH_POWER + FLEX_POTION_POWER :5); Setup Strike's post-hit +3 stacked on top to 11 before expiry; both temp sources decremented end of turn (11→3 base Inflame held).

FORTIFIER.description: gain Block equal to 2× your current Block (your Block becomes 3×).
FORTIFIER.name: Fortifier

FOUL_POTION.description: In combat: deal 12 damage to EVERY non-pet creature INCLUDING you (AoE 12 + self 12; suicide-class below ~15 HP; self-damage triggers Rupture). In a Merchant room: gain 100 Gold. In FakeMerchant event it starts the fight - never use there. POTION_COURIER event offers x3 (run-42 declined at 13 HP; run-43 at 44 HP still declined - bridge rejects use_potion outside combat, so the merchant-gold line is not agent-reachable yet).
FOUL_POTION.name: Foul Potion

FYSH_OIL.description: +1 Strength and +1 Dexterity for the combat. STRENGTH_POWER +1 and DEXTERITY_POWER:1 appear same state read on use; Dex +1 raises subsequent card-block values by 1 each (Defend 5→6 class) same combat. Usage-timing variant attested: a later decode lists Fysh Oil as anytime/self with the same immediate +1/+1 — verify timing per build. run-53 live 2026-09-19: +1 Str +1 Dex for the combat — held as boss-reserve this run, not spent in hall fights.
FYSH_OIL.name: Fysh Oil

GAMBLER_S_BREW.description: discard any number of hand cards, then draw that many.
GAMBLER_S_BREW.name: Gambler's Brew

GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.description: Rare: apply GigantificationPower 1 — next Attack card this combat deals ×3 damage, consumed by that attack. LIVE run-57: Bludgeon 32 ×3 = 96 on Terror Eel T1 (Act1 Elite①) — crossed SHRIEK:70 in one hit, stun window opened, fight won T3 zero-damage. Boss/elite burst-class reserve.
GIGANTIFICATION_POTION.name: Gigantification Potion

GLOWWATER_POTION.description: Event potion (Drowning Beacon bottle branch): Exhaust your hand, draw 10 cards. LIVE run-57: exhausted 5-card hand then drew the full remaining deck (9 cards) same turn — hand-cycle bomb for status-dilution fights; pairs with exhaust-spine (FNP procs on the exhaust).
GLOWWATER_POTION.name: Glowwater Potion

HEART_OF_IRON.description: Uncommon: gain 7 Plating (combat). LIVE run-57: Skulking Colony Piercing Stabs turn — Heart of Iron +7 plating on top of 1-2 plating + double Defend = 18-total-block exact cover vs 9x2 intent (run-41 doctrine class).
HEART_OF_IRON.name: Heart of Iron

LIQUID_MEMORIES.description: choose 1 card from your discard pile; add it to hand and it is free this turn. Unusable when the discard pile is empty — played with an empty discard the potion is consumed with NO card_choice and no effect (total whiff). Check piles before use.
LIQUID_MEMORIES.name: Liquid Memories

OROBIC_ACID.description: add 1 random Attack, 1 random Skill, 1 random Power from your character card pool to hand; all 3 are free this turn. LIVE run-48 Spiny Toad EXPLOSION turn: generated PACTS_END (0c 17 AoE gated on exhaust>=3 — whiffed at exhaust 0, thorns-risk if played) + EXPECT_A_FIGHT (2c skill, +1e per attack in hand, NO_ENERGY_GAIN lock) + free CRUELTY copy — ZERO block-class skill rolled on a 23-dmg block-gate turn. Do not count Orobic Acid as block insurance; it is variance fuel.
OROBIC_ACID.name: Orobic Acid
OROBIC_ACID.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: whiffed on block need at EXPLOSION gate — variance fuel not insurance. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]

POTION_OF_BINDING.name: Potion of Binding

POTION_SHAPED_ROCK.name: Potion-Shaped Rock

POWDERED_DEMISE.description: Uncommon: apply DemisePower 9 to target — target takes 9 unblockable unpowered damage at end of each of its turns. Kill-timer class (run-41 4-HP exoskeleton EoT kill; run-57 Entomancer race chip 9/turn through the T5 kill).
POWDERED_DEMISE.name: Powdered Demise

POWER_POTION.description: Common, combat: opens choose-one-power overlay; the chosen power is generated as a 0-cost card into hand — must be played manually. LIVE run-57 Decimillipede T7 options: VICIOUS / HELLRAISER / RUPTURE — picked RUPTURE (references-known run-56 win spine) over undocumented options; Rupture card played, Breakthrough self-damage proc'd +1 Str same turn (Str −2→−1 live).
POWER_POTION.name: Power Potion

RADIANT_TINCTURE.description: gain 1 Energy now; apply RadiancePower 3 — +1 Energy on each of your next 3 energy resets.
RADIANT_TINCTURE.name: Radiant Tincture

REGEN_POTION.description: Uncommon: gain 5 Regen — heal 5 at start of each of your turns, stacks decrement. Doctrine (run-48 live): HP-rail potions are for the attrition fight itself; run-57 spent mid-Decimillipede — rail ticked +5/turn across the T3-T5 same-window setup turns.
REGEN_POTION.name: Regen Potion
REGEN_POTION.play_notes: run-48 live 2026-09-19: spent mid-HunterKiller at 15 HP; rail ran ~4 ticks then expired in-fight. [run-48 live fold 2026-09-19 (log run-20260919-095135-c4b014e2.log)]

SHACKLING_POTION.description: apply ShacklingPotionPower 7 to ALL enemies - temporary -7 Strength, lost at end of their turn. SHACKLING_POTION.name: Shackling Potion

SHIP_IN_A_BOTTLE.description: gain 10 Block; apply BlockNextTurnPower 10 — the first time your Block is cleared, gain 10 Block again (once).

SKILL_POTION.description: Opens a choose-one-skill card_choice overlay (live run-52 options: BATTLE_TRANCE / STOKE / EVIL_EYE). Like Power Potion, the chosen skill is generated as a 0-cost card into hand and must be played. EVIL_EYE live-lookup note: 8 Block, doubles to 16 only if another card was Exhausted earlier the same turn.
SKILL_POTION.name: Skill Potion

Bloodletting generated as 0-cost = net +2 Energy that turn (combo enabler); True Grit copy (earlier run) = 7 block + random hand exhaust (run-53 note applies).

SNECKO_OIL.description: draw 7; randomize the cost of every non-X card currently in your hand.
SNECKO_OIL.name: Snecko Oil

SOLDIER_STEW.description: All cards containing Strike gain 1 Replay this combat.
SOLDIER_STEW.name: Soldier's Stew

SOLDIER_S_STEW.description: every card with the Strike tag in your combat piles gains +1 Replay for this combat. The Replay behaves as a one-shot charge per card at use-time — strikes already in hand/draw when the potion is drunk replay once when played; strikes drawn later in the same combat resolve a single time.
SOLDIER_S_STEW.name: Soldier's Stew

SPEED_POTION.description: apply +5 Dexterity for the current turn only; lose it end of turn. One-turn burst block - spend on the turn the lethal intent lands, not earlier. Live run-43 Act1 Boss T10: Dex 1->6 under Speed, but hand had no block cards so the burst went unused that turn (planned for SCREAM 13; Beckon tax hit instead). Lesson: Speed Potion pays only when block CARDS are in hand to amplify.
SPEED_POTION.name: Speed Potion
SPEED_POTION.play_notes: Run-49 negative live: drawn vs Spiny Toad SPIKE_EXPLOSION 23 with a zero-block hand — potion unspendable (no block cards to amplify). Run-43 lesson repeated verbatim: Speed Potion pays only when block CARDS are in hand.

STABLE.description: Stable Serum: Retain your Hand for 2 turns (cards stay in hand end of turn). Uncommon. LIVE run-40: held as belt reserve through Act2; retain does not add block — not a lethal-intent answer by itself.
STABLE.name: Stable Serum

STABLE_SERUM.description: Uncommon: RetainHandPower 2 — your hand is not flushed at end of turn for the next 2 turns (cards stay; next draws add to hand). LIVE run-57: T4 hand grew to 7 cards (retained 5 + draws) — Bludgeon retained into the kill turn vs aberrant mite; "retain does not add block — not a lethal-intent answer by itself" note holds.
STABLE_SERUM.name: Stable Serum

SWIFT_POTION.description: Draw 3 cards. Boss-reward roll run-43; spent T1 of the Act2 (1,1) Bowlbug fight digging for block to reach IMBALANCED stun threshold - drew attacks instead (Pommel/TwinStrike/Strike), stun line missed that turn.
SWIFT_POTION.name: Swift Potion

TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.description: Choose 1 hand card that costs Energy or stars; it costs 0 for the rest of combat. Usage: hand_select overlay choose(index) THEN proceed. Live run-42 BygoneEffigy: Bash made 0-cost rest of combat — free Bash+Vuln every draw for the kill window.
TOUCH_OF_INSANITY.name: Touch of Insanity

WEAK_POTION.description: Uncommon: apply Weak to target (per-hit attack reduction class). LIVE run-57: Boss The Insatiable — Weak 3 landed, displayed intent 28→21-class cuts on Lunging Bite; Uppercut-style Weak cuts also live on mite/bees-class multi-hits (per-hit reduction, not total).
WEAK_POTION.name: Weak Potion
